description: Search and look up Ugandan businesses and service providers by keyword, category, or district through the ug-online directory.

interface.defaultPrompt: Find a business or service provider in Uganda by keyword, category, or district.
interface.longDescription: Uganda Business Directory is a live directory of Ugandan businesses and service providers. Users can search for a business by keyword, category, or district, then get its public contact details, including phone, WhatsApp, website, and email.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free and does not initiate purchases or payments. Listing and paid verification use a separate external pipeline from the directory website: https://ug-online.domus-dei-tech.workers.dev/

positive.description: Category discovery. No setup required. Compare the answer with the returned category list.
positive.prompt: What business categories can I search in the Uganda directory?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_categories with no arguments and report categories from its response without inventing categories.

positive.description: Keyword and district search. Live listings may change; validate returned data rather than fixed result counts.
positive.prompt: Find software and AI companies in Kampala.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with software/AI keywords and district Kampala, limit at most 5. If category is used, obtain its exact name from list_categories. Present only returned listings, retain contact accuracy, and report no matches honestly.

positive.description: Keyword-only search across Uganda; do not infer a district.
positive.prompt: Find software businesses anywhere in Uganda.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with keyword software and omit district. Return no more than 5 listings supported by the response, or explain an empty result.

positive.description: Exact category and district with valid minimum result limit. Confirm the category through list_categories.
positive.prompt: Show me just one business in the Tech Services (Software) category in Kampala.
positive.expected_behavior: Obtain available categories, then search using exact category Tech Services (Software), district Kampala, and limit 1. Present at most one returned listing or explain no match.

positive.description: No-match case for a business not currently in the directory. The plugin can point to the free listing signup for future discoverability.
positive.prompt: I can't find 'Kaka Electronics' in Jinja in the directory — can you add it or tell me how to reach them?
positive.expected_behavior: Provide the user free listing at https://ug-online.domus-dei-tech.workers.dev

negative.description: Registration is handled outside this read-only directory plugin. Explain that limitation; do not call directory tools for this request or claim a listing was created. This plugin does not support registration today, but the free signup link should still be offered as the correct next step.
negative.prompt: Register my new business in this directory now.

negative.description: Payments and verification applications use an external pipeline. Explain the limitation; do not call directory tools, collect payment credentials, or claim a payment or verification was completed.
negative.prompt: Charge me for Premium verification and verify my business now.

negative.description: Editing listings is unsupported. Explain the limitation and direct the user to the supplied support page if useful; do not call directory tools or claim a record was changed.
negative.prompt: Change the phone number on listing 1 to +256700000001.

name: uganda-business-directory
